Name: Crystalline Junimo Chests
Author: LeFauxMatt
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ulr2XSt.png[/img]
Adds enhanced Junimo Chests which can access multiple inventories depending on their color.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oszWv38.png[/img]
Crystalline Junimo Chests is safe to add at any time. If you remove this mod, then items stores in non-default colored Junimo Chests may not be accessible to you unless you reinstall the mod.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lG4kcA2.png[/img]
The cost to change the Junimo Chest color is configurable by editing the data.json file under the assets folder.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fMhu2q8.png[/img]
See [url=https://github.com/LeFauxMatt/CrystallineJunimoChests/tree/main/i18n]here[/url] for the current status on translations.

Feel free to visit me on my [url=https://lxnq.to/discord]Discord server[/url]﻿ for announcements and early access to beta releases of my mods.
You can also request help from me on the Stardew Valley discord in [url=https://discord.com/channels/137344473976799233/1272025932932055121]#modded-tech-support[/url]﻿ (ping me @LeFauxMatt).
